description: Given an inclusion embedding A into B, an injective function f from B to the naturals with coinfinite range, and an injection g from A differing finitely from the restriction of f, every finite reserve disjoint from the range of g can be avoided by an injective extension h of g to B which differs finitely from f and has coinfinite range.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.finite_repair.{u, v} {A : Type u} {B : Type v} (ι : A ↪ B) (f : B → ℕ) (g : A → ℕ)
  (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfc : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.CoinfiniteRange f) (hg : Function.Injective g)
  (heq : g =ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] f ∘ ⇑ι) (R : Set ℕ) (hR : R.Finite) (hdisj : Disjoint (Set.range g) R) :
  ∃ h,
    Function.Injective h ∧
      h ∘ ⇑ι = g ∧
        h =ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] f ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.CoinfiniteRange h ∧ Disjoint (Set.range h) R
